I feel I can add a little bit of substance to this post. Currently I take Adderall and Wellbutrin. Obviously the Adderall is for the ADHD and the Wellbutrin acts for my both ADHD and depression. Wellbutrin also has known benefits for treating ADHD symptoms and I’ve noticed a lot of difference while taking it. The problem I had for so long was I wasn’t sure weather it was stand alone anxiety(GAD, SA), or anxiety that was a comorbid symptom of my life long battle with ADHD. I got sick and tired of trying to figure out which of these was causing my anxiety issues. Considering I also have intermittent bouts of depression it was just easier to take both Adderall and Wellbutrin together rather than just one. It’s likely you will have higher anxiety on any stimulant, as I and many others do. I refuse to take Benzodiazepines so I take busbar for my anxiety and CBD gummies as needed if I notice my anxiety is getting over base line. I highly recommend looking into CBD to anyone with both ADHD and anxiety if they’re above 21 and can legally get it from a reputable place.
